verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports environments and secret variables within environments (hoppscotch-docs-7) and self-hosting for full data ownership (hoppscotch-docs-14), which could be used to separate sandbox from production configs, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'sandbox mode' or mock server feature for AI-native testing. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/mock environment feature, documentation on isolating test traffic from production, AI-agent-specific sandbox workflow guidance.
